soh_definition: Existing SOH = measured QDischarge / mean QDischarge at cycles <=50 *100; reference not a predictor.

rul_endpoint.event_time: Nth consecutive observed cycle below threshold; exact consecutive cycle numbers required; no backdating
rul_endpoint.regression_cohort: Confirmed events only; censored trajectories excluded from regression; selection-biased conditional estimate, not population survival.

warnings: No measured SOH below 70%; reliable 50-70% accuracy is unsupported.
RUL requires observed history and is unavailable for single assessment.
